# Third-party libraries

Shipped with the editor so it works without loading code from a CDN. Fetched
and verified by [`packaging/vendor.py`](../../packaging/vendor.py) (SHA-256 in
`packaging/vendor.lock.json`); don't edit these files by hand.

| Folder | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `leaflet/` | [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com/) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`) |
| `three/` | [three.js](https://threejs.org/) | 0.169.0 | MIT (`three/LICENSE`) |
| `psv/` | [Photo Sphere Viewer](https://photo-sphere-viewer.js.org/) core, markers and virtual-tour plugins | 5.11.5 | MIT (`psv/*/LICENSE`) |
| `exifr/` | [exifr](https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr) | 7.1.3 | MIT (`exifr/LICENSE`) |
| `mediapipe/` | [MediaPipe Tasks Vision](https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe) and the BlazeFace face detector models | 1.0.1 | [Apache-2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) |
| `manrope/` | [Manrope](https://github.com/sharanda/manrope) font (via Fontsource) | 5.0.19 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`manrope/LICENSE`) |
